notes: ACCESS: reached only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector, in my own tab, no HTTP client of any kind. robots.txt was read first: it has a single 'User-agent: *' block with a short path deny-list (/account, /checkout, /cart, /wishlist, /s/, /h/, /orders/, ...) and no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-User directive and no full-site disallow, so category listings are permitted. TREE: built from https://www.xxxlutz.de/sitemap-categories.xml (5,668 <loc> entries) fetched by same-origin fetch() from the loaded page. Query-string facet variants were stripped (1,256 canonical category URLs remain). Every URL carries a hierarchical breadcrumb code '<slug>-C<id>C<id>...', which decodes directly into the site's own category tree; the 50 top-level departments were enumerated and each was inspected for furniture-typed children. QTY: XXXLutz is a React SPA, but a document-style request (Accept: text/html) returns server-rendered HTML embedding __APOLLO_STATE__ with a pagination block {pageSize, totalPages, totalResults} for the listing. qty = totalResults. This is the same number the page prints in its rendered header: navigating to /couchtische-C1C4C1 in the tab showed the header '13.796 Artikel' and __APOLLO_STATE__ on that live page gave totalResults=13796, pageSize=60, totalPages=230. SANITY CHECKS: (a) the exhaustion check ceil(totalResults/60)==totalPages passed for all 240 nodes fetched, with pageSize stable at 60 everywhere (no page-size A/B drift); (b) counts discriminate strongly between siblings (e.g. Lounge Stools 12 vs Kitchen Sofas 4 vs Beds 148,636), so no site-wide constant; (c) no suspiciously round display caps; (d) roughly 45% of first-attempt SSR fetches returned the bare SPA shell with no pagination block - these were retried until a real SSR render was obtained rather than being recorded as 0 or guessed. HIERARCHY: parents that are genuinely partitioned by their children are emitted as grouping rows (qty/link null) with the children as leaves - verified numerically, e.g. Wall Units 18,854 vs children 18,809 (99.8%), Living Room Tables 20,913 vs 21,223, Armchairs 15,565 vs 15,302. Where the site's children are overlapping facet cuts rather than a partition, the parent is kept as the leaf and the facet children dropped: Sofa Beds (9,180; children box-spring/with-storage/fold-out sum to only 2,182 = 24%), Dining Chairs (27,221; with-armrests/cantilever/four-leg/shell sum to 20,763 and overlap each other), Garden Chairs (3,610 vs 576), Garden Tables (2,919 vs 762), Desk Pedestals (1,031 vs 310). DROPPED AS FACET RE-CUTS (never as categories, per the price/colour/material-filter rule): all '<parent>-<material/finish/shape/size/count>' nodes - Couchtische Metall/Glas/Marmor/Marmoroptik/Keramik/mit Rollen/hoehenverstellbar/mit Stauraum, Beistelltische Metall/Glas, Esstische ausziehbar/rund/oval/quadratisch/Hochglanz/Keramik, Glastische, Baumkantentische, Ledersofas, Lederstuehle, Metallbetten, Kleiderschraenke 2-/3-/4-tuerig and mit Spiegel, XXL-Sitzsaecke, Lowboards haengend, Gartenstuehle stapelbar. Confirmed empirically: on /couchtische-C1C4C1 the site renders these as a flat quick-link strip under the H1 that also contains 'Couchtische rund' and 'Couchtische eckig', which have no category code at all - i.e. it is a filter strip, not a taxonomy level. DROPPED WHOLESALE: the entire 'Holzmoebel' department (C70, 44 nodes) - it is a pure material cross-cut that duplicates the main tree node-for-node (esstische-holz, couchtische-holz, holzbetten, kleiderschraenke-holz, schuhschraenke-holz, ...); counting it would double-count the whole furniture catalogue. EXCLUDED PER RULESET: mattresses and mattress accessories (matratzen-shop C3C17, babymatratzen), slatted bed bases (lattenroste C3C7) and Bettkasten bed drawers, air beds; all lighting (C84) and all mirrors (C24, garderobenspiegel, badspiegel, beleuchtete spiegel); rugs and flooring (C11), all textiles (C81/C82/C83, outdoor cushions C74); decoration (C22), pictures and frames (C23), wallpaper (C25); tableware/cookware/kitchen appliances (C2, C30, C31, C32, C33, C34, C53, kuechenelektrogeraete C41C3, kuechenausstattung C41C4); bathroom fixtures and accessories (waschbecken/armaturen C4C5, WC C4C7, badewannen/duschen C4C9, badaccessoires C27) and 'Badeinrichtungen' C4C6 - opened it and the products are HANDTUCHHALTER/HANDTUCHSTANGE/HANDTUCHTROCKNER (towel rails), not furniture; standalone storage goods (baskets, boxes, organisers under C26 - only Truhen kept); parts/accessories nodes (schrankzubehoer, schreibtischplatte, buerostuhl-ersatzteile, regalbefestigungen, tv-wandhalterung, gartentischgestelle/-platten, kinderbettzubehoer, wickelaufsaetze, hochstuhlzubehoer, garderobenhaken/kleiderbuegel/schluesselboards/schirmstaender); wood stoves and firewood racks (C17); garden sheds and storage boxes (C73); camping chairs/tables under Leisure > Camping (C76C7) and workshop benches/heavy-duty racking (C76C5C6) as gear rather than furniture; pet sofas/beds (C76C13); baby travel gear (C44), baby bouncers, toys (C56), clothing (C60/C85). OVERLAP NOTE: Garden Furniture (C8), Balcony Furniture (C35) and Lounge Furniture (C71) are three separate top-level departments on the site and their product sets partly overlap; they are emitted as the site presents them.
